messages:
taylor: Hey sec folks — quick check. We're provisioning a temporary audit role for SRE to debug the new tenant pipeline. They need read-only access to logs in project:tenant-prod for 48h. Any concerns about PII exposure or do we need redaction/filtering? TL;DR: which role and approval flow?

maya: @taylor good call. Is this for full log viewer or limited to Cloud Logging (tailing)? If logs contain user PII we should gate access. Who's the SRE on duty?

taylor: Samir (oncall) will be doing the access. It's for realtime tailing and link-to-GCS if exports exist. Not for bulk export.

alessia: For tailing, prefer `roles/logging.viewer` + a scoped custom role to drop export reads. Console RBAC can't easily exclude bucket exports, so custom role is safer. Minimal perms: `logging.logEntries.list`, `logging.logEntries.get`, maybe `resourcemanager.projects.get` for project browse.

maya: We should also require Access Approval + two approvers (sec lead + product). Approver: maya + product-owner. Add explicit expiry (48h) and record the justification in ENG-4981. Also add "no external copies" in the approval text.

samir: I can approve once the role is scoped. @taylor can you open a tiny PR with the role json and link it here?

taylor: Done — PR up: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/+/PR-2116. Includes a proposed custom role `customTenantLogReader` and the temporary binding. PTAL.

alessia: Quick review: remove `storage.objects.get` from the role (we don't want bucket-level reads). Instead add a log-only permission. Add a condition to auto-expire the binding: `request.time < timestamp(\"2026-03-20T12:00:00Z\")`.

maya: Agreed. Also add expected scope: only `projects/tenant-prod/logs/*` (no org-level). I'll approve in Access Approvals after PR merge.

samir: Can confirm I'll only tail and will redact any screenshot.

access-bot: Access request recorded: AR-87321. Requester: samir. Approvers notified: maya, product-owner. Expiry: 48h.

deploy-bot: Grant applied: `serviceAccount:sre-temp@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com -> roles/customTenantLogReader` (expires in 48h) :white_check_mark:

samir: Got it, thanks. I'll proceed and update ENG-4981 with a short postmortem if we observe any PII. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks team — one more thing: add a quick caveat in the PR description that logs may contain user identifiers and must not be copied to external trackers. I'll merge once the export reads are removed.

taylor: Merged and added the note. Closing loop here.
